tweaks.name: Install Windhawk
tweaks.description: Installs Windhawk's Windows customization marketplace through WinGet.
tweaks.impact: Adds opt-in shell and application mods managed by Windhawk.
tweaks.tradeoff: Windhawk mods use process injection and hooking. Review every mod, author, source, and compatibility note before enabling it.

tweaks.name: Install CrystalDiskInfo
tweaks.description: Installs CrystalDiskInfo for SMART drive-health and temperature diagnosis.
tweaks.impact: Adds read-only disk health visibility for SSDs and hard drives.

tweaks.name: Install HWMonitor
tweaks.description: Installs HWMonitor for CPU, GPU, motherboard, fan, voltage, and temperature monitoring.
tweaks.impact: Adds hardware sensor diagnosis without changing clocks or fan curves.
tweaks.tradeoff: Sensor polling adds a small amount of overhead while the application is running.
